items.title: Approve the Minutes of the May 19, 2026 Meeting
Adopt the Inner Sunset Transportation Study Final Report
Allocate $22,651,000 in Prop L Funds and Allocate $1,860,572 in Prop AA Funds, with Conditions, for Ten Requests
Amend the Prop K Standard Grant Agreement for the District 2 Safety Study and Implementation to Update the Project Scope, Schedule, Cost, and Funding Plan
Adopt the Proposed Fiscal Year 2026/27 Budget and Work Program

Allocate $180,800 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency and Appropriate $49,900 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, for the Central Subway North Beach Extension Study
Adopt the Geary/19th Ave Subway and Regional Connections Study Final Report
Authorize an Additional Construction Allotment of $2,000,000, for a Revised Additional Construction Allotment Not to Exceed 3,896,564
Award a Construction Contract to the Lowest Responsible and Responsive Bidder, Gordon N. Ball, Inc., in an Amount Not to Exceed $12,351,339 Other Items
